# Learning with Errors

> Chat-style explainers with live demos, at the pace of a 2009 MSN conversation.

Every page below is also served as HTML at the same path without the `.md`.
The whole-site index is https://aadhar.sh/llms.txt.

## Pages

- [Learning with Errors](https://aadhar.sh/lwe.md): Chat-style explainers with live demos, at the pace of a 2009 MSN conversation.
- [FHE](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/fhe.md): Fully Homomorphic Encryption, explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN conversation. The teacher's lines are verbatim from an Archetype essay; the learner and demos are AI.
- [MPC](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/mpc.md): Multi-Party Computation explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN chat: honest majority, dishonest majority, and traitor tracing, with a live node demo. Teacher lines verbatim from an Archetype essay.
- [TEE](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/tee.md): Trusted Execution Environments explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN chat: the secret room in the chip, and the side-channels that leak it. Teacher lines verbatim from an Archetype essay.
- [UTF-8](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/utf8.md): Text encoding explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN chat: ASCII vs UTF-32 vs UTF-8, with live byte demos. First-pass draft; the demos compute real bytes.
- [Vigenère](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/vigenere.md): The Vigenère cipher (and Kryptos) explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN chat: keyed alphabets, autokeys, K1–K3, and how you crank a Kryptos-shaped problem and score the noise. Live workbench and statistics demos.
- [Image encoding](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/encoding.md): Why one photo gives three file sizes, explained at the pace of an MSN chat. AVIF against JPEG against the tuned JPEG encoders (mozjpeg, jpegli, zenjpeg), with a bytes-per-pixel demo that fetches the real encoded files live.
- [Programmable cryptography](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/pcrypto.md): Programmable cryptography explained at the pace of a 2009 MSN chat: 2PC and garbled circuits, SNARKs, FHE, and ORAM as one toolkit. A fair-use walkthrough of the 0xPARC primer, with a live SHA-256 preimage demo.
- [DAC](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/dac.md): Why DAC nerds fight about multibit versus delta-sigma, explained at MSN-chat pace. An R-2R ladder you can mismatch, a multibit staircase, a live noise-shaping DFT, an audible bit-depth demo, a reconstruction filter showing the time-frequency tradeoff, and a tube stage you can overdrive into even or odd harmonics. Leans on Schiit Happened and head-fi, cited.
- [Headphone drivers](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/drivers.md): Planar magnetic versus dynamic headphone drivers, explained at MSN-chat pace. A live diaphragm-motion demo: a dynamic cone driven at one point breaks up at high frequency, while a planar film driven everywhere stays flat.
- [Knots](https://aadhar.sh/lwe/knots.md): Why your shoelaces come undone, explained at MSN-chat pace. Granny versus square, the Ian knot, and bunny ears, with a live demo: toggle the second crossing's handedness and pull to watch one lock and the other slip.
